title: PLAYER 2 KEEPS THE CONVOY WHEN THE HOST LEAVES
why: His ruling: when the host is gone the remaining player picks up the raid. If the host left during the 20 second warning of a machine convoy, player 2's window started the convoy itself, but the host never sent where the convoy was going (only the host picks the destination), so the carrier was steered to NaN: the carrier and its armoured crawlers vanished off the map, the map mark was lost, KILL THE CARRIER could not be done and the event ran out with no crate. Proven in a staged pair: host launches a convoy, the world word goes to player 2, the host goes out, player 2 runs it live: carrier at NaN,NaN with destination undefined. The world word now carries the destination, player 2 takes it, and the carrier is never steered to a NaN point.
now: If your host leaves while a machine convoy is on its way, the convoy still comes and you can still kill the carrier for its crate.
